answer_states.NOT_SHOWN: Item not displayed to this unit. Not an answer. Excluded from A and V.
answer_states.SKIPPED: Item displayed, no answer recorded. Excluded from A and V.
answer_states.REFUSED: Item displayed, explicit refusal. Counted in A as an answer event (A10 line 41), never in V. Reported separately from DONOTKNOW. Never converted to SKIPPED and never to AREA_OUTSIDE.
answer_states.INVALID: Item displayed, answer fails a validity rule (bad code, exclusive conflict, cap exceeded). Counted in A as an answer event; never in V. A10 line 41: 'an answer event (valid, invalid or explicit non-substantive option)'. Scope: exclusive-conflict and bad-code triggers do NOT apply to Q01 — Q01 dispositions come only from items[0].eligibility_effect.disposition_rule (PROPOSED_PENDING_SD_A); a Q01 invalid-screen unit exits via the SCREEN_INVALID partition term, counted in A_pre.
answer_states.ANSWERED_SUBSTANTIVE: Item displayed, answer recorded, answer is substantive for this item. Counted in A and in V.
answer_states.ANSWERED_NON_SUBSTANTIVE: Item displayed, answer recorded, answer is an explicit non-substantive option for this item. Counted in A, NOT in V. Scope: excludes any option whose option_to_state_map value is REFUSED (e.g. PREFER_NOT_TO_ANSWER on Q02/Q04..Q13, DECLINE on Q03) — those are REFUSED events, per refusal_and_state_semantics.answer_state_precedence_rule.

unit_exclusions.UNDER_AGE: Excluded before Q. Kept as its own reason, never merged with area exclusion.
unit_exclusions.REJECTED_RESPONSE: Response unit rejected on an accepted/rejected review (quality, contradiction, policy). Excluded before Q. Distinct from INVALID, which is an item-level answer state.
unit_exclusions.NOT_ASSESSED: Qualification never evaluated. Excluded from Q and reported separately from UNKNOWN: 'we did not check' and 'we checked and could not tell' are different facts.

geographic_exclusions.AREA_OUTSIDE: Geographic predicate returned NO. Excluded from Q. Counted and reported separately.
geographic_exclusions.AREA_UNKNOWN: Geographic predicate returned UNKNOWN. Excluded from Q. Never promoted to eligible. Counted and reported separately. The qualification result is NOT_COMPUTABLE.

primary_suppression.rule: A cell whose count is below the Owner-declared floor k is suppressed before publication.
primary_suppression.note: This package does not set k. The directive forbids inventing a statistical or privacy threshold, and IR07 declined to approve one.

complementary_suppression.rule: If any cell in a released table is suppressed, at least one additional cell in the same row or column must also be suppressed, chosen so that no suppressed cell can be recovered by subtraction from published totals or marginals.
complementary_suppression.why_structural: The control constrains the SHAPE of what is published, not the size of any count. It is therefore binding without a numeric threshold.

cross_view_differencing_check.rule: No two published views (tables, versions, releases) may differ by exactly one suppressed cell. Where a release is versioned, each successive release must be checked against its predecessor for single-cell differencing.
cross_view_differencing_check.why_structural: Closes the withdrawal-plus-versioning route recorded as PV-8 (CRITICAL) by IR07.

residual_bucket_required.rule: Any suppressed residual must be published as a residual bucket (for example 'other / suppressed') large enough that the suppressed cells are not individually recoverable.

prohibited: Publishing a suppressed cell with no complementary suppression
Publishing two views that differ by exactly one suppressed cell
Recovering a suppressed cell by subtraction from totals
